name: Sikalastic®-701
tagline: Polyurethane hybrid elastic top coat for liquid applied membrane waterproofing systems
summary: Sikalastic®-701 is a 2-part, polyurethane hybrid, gloss finish top coat for Sika® Liquid Applied Membrane waterproofing systems. Sikalastic®-701 is commonly used in conjunction with SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems and can also be used with Sikalastic® polyurea systems.
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-701 is a 2-part, polyurethane hybrid, gloss finish top coat for Sika® Liquid Applied Membrane waterproofing systems. Sikalastic®-701 is commonly used in conjunction with SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems and can also be used with Sikalastic® polyurea systems.
attributes: Aliphatic polyurethane providing UV and yellowing resistance
Good colour stability and gloss retention
Suitable for cool roofs by providing a high Solar Reflective Index

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Confirm waiting /overcoating time has been achieved on the previously applied system base layer. The base layer must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and loose material. If dust exists on the surface, it must be completely removed before application of the product, preferably by vacuum extraction equipment.
If the maximum overcoating time of the base layer is exceeded, the surface must be lightly abraded using light abrasive manual tools or mechanical equipment to roughen the surface. Depending on the type of base layer, a solvent wipe may also be required. Finally, completely remove all the dust by vacuum extraction equipment.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Prior to mixing all parts, mix separately Part A (resin) using an electric single or double paddle mixer and stirrer (300 to 400 rpm) or other suitable equipment. Mix liquid and all the coloured pigment until a uniform colour / mix has been achieved. Add Part B (hardener) to Part A and mix Part A + B continuously for 3,0 minutes until a uniformly coloured mix has been achieved. Mix full units only. Mixing time for A+B = ~3,0 minutes.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Apply mixed product in 1 coat by roller, brush or spray equipment to achieve a consistent thickness and required surface finish.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically or with a proprietary paint stripper.
